race.comment: Intriguing contest. ICE KOOL (9) can't draw a decent gate and today is no different. Raced fiercely when he covered ground early and dropped out sharply in the straight when eleventh over 1100m at Randwick in BM88 grade. Saves his best for this course and distance and gets another chance with Zac Lloyd taking the reins. SILVER WEDDING (8) classy mare resuming who was stakes placed over the winter. Comes to hand quickly and fitted with the two trials. Maps well and sure to go close. MAL COUPE (3) tough sprinter who comes back a few levels after running some tidy races in Group company. Showed good early dash and not that far away when sixth over 1100m in the G2 The Shorts at Randwick. Can hold a position from the draw and go close. HIDDEN MOTIVE (7) tongue-tie goes on second up after he faded in the straight when tenth over 1100m at Randwick in BM88 grade. Drops in weight and look for a much better performance. The chances don't end there.
